_about: Licence summaries for the asset sources Motionmaker knows. Each was read from the source's own page on the date in checkedOn. They are SUMMARIES, not legal advice, and a single asset can carry different terms from its collection: always confirm on the asset's own page and record that page's URL in the ledger. Unknown = blocked.

CC0-1.0.name: CC0 1.0 Public Domain Dedication
CC0-1.0.note: Open Peeps, Humaaans and Open Doodles by Pablo Stanley state CC0 on their own sites. No credit required; crediting is still good manners.

LOTTIEFILES-SIMPLE.name: LottieFiles Simple License (public animations)
restrictions: modified versions must carry the same terms
no additional or different terms may be imposed
no technical measures restricting the granted rights
do not compile Files to replicate or build a competing service
LOTTIEFILES-SIMPLE.note: Applies to public animation files on lottiefiles.com. Attribution is not required but strongly encouraged. Premium or creator-restricted files are different: check the animation's page.

UNDRAW.name: unDraw license
restrictions: no redistribution in packs or as a collection
no competing service built from the assets
no AI/ML training or datasets without written permission
bundled brand logos are trademarks: use only to represent that brand
UNDRAW.note: Free for commercial use, no credit needed.

CC-BY-4.0.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0
restrictions: credit the creator, link the licence, and indicate if you changed the work
seenOn: https://rive.app/docs/community/community-overview (Rive Community / Marketplace files are shared under CC BY)
CC-BY-4.0.note: Rive community files: attribution REQUIRED. Put the credit in the video (end card) or the post, and keep it in the ledger.

MIT.name: MIT (code)
restrictions: keep the copyright and licence notice when you redistribute the CODE
MIT.note: Covers software only (lottie-web, @rive-app/canvas, react-peeps by Emre Cakir, humaaans npm by jktzes). It does not describe the artwork inside a wrapper package; the art keeps its own licence (CC0 for Open Peeps and Humaaans).

ISC.name: ISC (permissive, like MIT)
restrictions: keep the notice when you redistribute the source files
ISC.note: Lucide icons (lucide-static), d3, world-atlas. Icons rendered in a video need no credit.

APACHE-2.0.name: Apache License 2.0
restrictions: keep the licence and NOTICE when you redistribute the source files
APACHE-2.0.note: Google Material Symbols. Icons rendered in a video need no credit.

OFL-1.1.name: SIL Open Font License 1.1
restrictions: fonts may not be sold on their own
OFL-1.1.note: Fontsource fonts bundled per look (fonts/FONTS.md travels with the project). Using the font in a video needs no credit.

USER-OWNED.name: Made or owned by the user/client
restrictions: the user confirms they own the rights
USER-OWNED.note: Use for the client's own illustrations, logos and animations.

PAID-LICENSED.name: Purchased or subscription licence (user supplies the terms)
restrictions: record the licence name, order or plan, and the URL of the terms; confirm video/ad use and redistribution of the source file are allowed
PAID-LICENSED.note: For paid kits (for example from marketplaces). Many forbid redistributing the source file; our output is a rendered video, but check.

UNKNOWN.name: Unknown
restrictions: do not ship: find the licence first

open-peeps.name: Open Peeps
open-peeps.creator: Pablo Stanley
open-peeps.get: SVG/PNG singles or the full library (Gumroad link on the site). Or build characters locally: node scripts/kit.mjs setup && node scripts/kit.mjs peep ... (uses the MIT 'react-peeps' package as the renderer).

humaaans.name: Humaaans
humaaans.creator: Pablo Stanley
humaaans.get: Library via Gumroad link on the site, or build locally with kit.mjs human (uses the MIT 'humaaans' npm package parts).

lottiefiles.name: LottieFiles (public animations)
lottiefiles.creator: various; record the creator on each animation's page
lottiefiles.get: Download as Lottie JSON from the animation page (a .lottie file is a zip: unzip it and use animations/*.json). Record the animation page URL.

rive-community.name: Rive Community / Marketplace
rive-community.creator: various; record the creator
rive-community.get: Download the .riv from the file page (or remix it in the Rive editor and export). Attribution required.

undraw.name: unDraw
undraw.creator: Katerina Limpitsouni / unDraw
undraw.get: Download one SVG at a time from the site with your brand colour set. No bulk downloading.
